title: 第18章 探秘药圃，喜获灵种
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
黑风岭西麓有一条早已干涸的古河道，河床里铺满了被山洪冲刷了不知多少年的鹅卵石。

    越往西走，草木越稀疏，空气中弥漫着一股淡淡的腐朽气息——不是尸体的腐臭，更像是某种极其古老的植物在泥土深处缓慢碳化散发出的气味。

    苏余手中的玉简微微发热。

    时之共鸣在这里达到了前所未有的强度——玉简上光图显示的标记点就在前方不到三里处，但眼前只有一片长满枯藤的乱石崖壁。

    “就是这里。”

    苏余停下脚步，将玉简收起。

    林霜站在他身后，环顾四周。

    以炼气九层的灵觉扫过方圆百丈，她感知不到任何异常——没有灵力波动，没有禁制痕迹，没有任何人工建筑残留，就是一面普普通通的山崖石壁。

    如果不知道入口在何处，就算从这片崖壁前走过一千次，也不会多看一眼。

    苏余走向崖壁，将手背上的“时”字篆文按在一块看似普通的石面上。

    暗金色的光芒从手背涌出，崖壁上无声无息地浮现出一圈圈金色纹路。

    纹路如游蛇般向四面八方蔓延，在石壁上勾勒出一扇高约丈许的门形轮廓。

    门形轮廓内石面如水波般荡漾开来，露出一个幽深的洞口。

    一股被封存了不知多少万年的古老灵气从洞口涌出，扑面而来的空气中带着若有若无的药草清香。

    苏余回头看了林霜一眼。

    林霜已经自觉地退到了十丈外的一块巨石旁，背靠石壁，双臂交叉，姿态悠闲但剑柄始终在触手可及的位置。

    她没有问能不能进去，也没有朝洞口方向张望，只是安静地站在外围，像一个哨兵。

    苏余收回目光，迈步踏入洞口。

    门内的世界与外面的荒芜判若两个天地。

    那是一座被穹顶笼罩的巨大药圃，目测方圆不下千丈。

    穹顶是某种半透明的玉石打磨而成，日光透过穹顶洒下来被过滤成了温和的乳白色光晕。

    空气中弥漫的灵气浓度远超外界，每一次呼吸都像在吸入一口液态的灵气——苏余估算，这里的灵气浓度至少是外界的二十倍，比青云宗的修炼密室还要浓郁。

    地面上铺着一层厚厚的腐殖土，踩上去松软如棉，那是数千年来药草枯荣交替积累出的灵土。

    但药圃里已没有灵药了。

    目之所及只有成片的荒芜灵田，田垄的轮廓仍在，但田垄之间已长满了不知名的杂草。

    杂草在灵气的滋养下疯长，又因为没有灵石矿脉支撑而枯死，如此反复千年，地面上堆积了一层厚达数尺的腐草层。
content_en:
At the western foot of Heifeng Ridge, there is an ancient river that has dried up long ago. The river bed is covered with pebbles that have been washed away by flash floods for countless years.

    The farther west you go, the sparser the vegetation becomes, and there is a faint smell of decay in the air - not the smell of a corpse, but more like the smell emitted by some extremely ancient plants that are slowly carbonized deep in the soil.

    The jade slip in Su Yu's hand was slightly warm.

    The resonance of time has reached an unprecedented intensity here - the marked point shown on the jade slip map is less than three miles ahead, but there is only a rocky cliff covered with withered vines in front of us.

    "This is it."

    Su Yu stopped and put away the jade slip.

    Lin Shuang stood behind him and looked around.

    With the spiritual sense of the ninth level of Qi Refining, she could not detect any abnormality within a hundred feet of the area - no fluctuations in spiritual power, no traces of restrictions, no traces of any artificial structures, just an ordinary cliff and stone wall.

    If you don't know where the entrance is, you won't take a second look even if you pass by this cliff a thousand times.

    Su Yu walked towards the cliff and pressed the seal character "Shi" on the back of his hand onto a seemingly ordinary stone surface.

    Dark golden light gushed out from the back of his hand, and circles of golden lines appeared silently on the cliff.

    The lines spread in all directions like snakes, outlining the outline of a door about ten feet high on the stone wall.

    The stone surface within the door-shaped outline ripples like water waves, revealing a deep hole.

    An ancient spiritual energy that had been sealed for countless thousands of years gushes out from the entrance of the cave, and the air that blows towards your face is filled with the faint fragrance of herbs.

    Su Yu looked back at Lin Shuang.

    Lin Shuang had consciously retreated to a boulder ten feet away, leaning against the stone wall with his arms crossed, his posture relaxed but the hilt of the sword always within reach.

    She didn't ask if she could go in, nor did she look toward the entrance of the cave. She just stood quietly on the outside, like a sentinel.

    Su Yu withdrew his gaze and stepped into the cave entrance.

    The world inside the door is completely different from the desolation outside.

    It was a huge medicinal garden covered by a dome, with a radius of no less than a thousand feet.

    The dome is made of some kind of translucent jade, and the sunlight shines through the dome and is filtered into a gentle milky white halo.

    The concentration of spiritual energy permeating the air far exceeds that of the outside world, and every breath is like inhaling a mouthful of liquid spiritual energy. Su Yu estimates that the concentration of spiritual energy here is at least twenty times that of the outside world, and is richer than the Qingyun Sect's secret cultivation chamber.

    The ground is covered with a thick layer of humus soil, which is as soft as cotton when stepped on. It is the spiritual soil accumulated by the alternation of withering and blooming of medicinal herbs over thousands of years.

    But there is no magic medicine left in the medicine garden.

    As far as the eye can see, there are only stretches of deserted spiritual fields. The outlines of the field ridges are still there, but unknown weeds have grown between them.

    The weeds grew wildly under the nourishment of spiritual energy, and then withered because there was no support from the spiritual stone veins. This repeated for thousands of years, and a layer of rotting grass several feet thick accumulated on the ground.
title_en: Chapter 18 Exploring the secret medicine garden and finding spiritual seeds
